name: Melierre
source:
Melierre – is a character in Heralds of the Avirentes - Ch. 1 Wings of Change and a Nandaar's niece.
A young black azure-eyed light-horned om'verai with serious face and long darker nose & back spikes.
Melierre's personality remains unknown.
